content: Definition, scope, key concepts (data, information, KPIs), evolution
from traditional reporting to modern tools like Excel and R, Brief
comparison with diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics,
Business intelligence (BI) Overview – Components, Importance in
decision-making, Descriptive Analytics in BI – Role within BI
frameworks and workflows to support data interpretation and
business insights, Data Models (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema),
Decision Support Systems (DSS), Trends and Innovations in DSS,
Marketing: Campaign ROI, market basket analysis
Understand structured, unstructured, Data Collection & Preparation
Importance of data quality, cleansing, and preprocessing, Data
transformation techniques, EDA Overview – Introduces the purpose
and steps of exploratory data analysis for uncovering patterns and
anomalies, Descriptive Statistics –Analyze data using measures of
central tendency, Frequency distribution, percentiles, quartiles,
dispersion, skewness, and kurtosis, Data Visualization using
different plots.¬¬¬¬¬ Business Application: Healthcare- Patient
analysis, Resource allocation and Utilization.

chapters.chapter_name: Statistical Methods and Advanced Data Analysis
content: Measures of Central Tendency, Measures of Dispersion, visualizing
descriptive Statistics, Histograms and box plots, Probability
Distributions – Discrete Distributions– Binomial and Poisson
distributions, Continuous Distributions – Normal and Exponential
distributions, Fitting Data to Distributions, Hypothesis Testing
Procedure, Statistical Tests – Z-test, t-test (One-Sample, Two
Sample), Chi-square test, and ANOVA, P-Value and Decision
Rules, Business Application- Finance: Risk Management, fraud
detection, portfolio analysis

chapters.chapter_name: Data Visualization and Business Intelligence Tools
content: Principles of Data Visualization- importance, applications, Data
Storytelling- Key concepts: narrative structure, core message,
emotional engagement, Business Intelligence Tools- Power BI: Data
Preparation & Modeling, Power BI Visualizations, PivotTables,
PivotCharts, Reporting & Dashboard Development, Business case
Studies: Sales Dashboard Implementation, HR analytics,
Challenges, Solution
Setting up Environment (Anaconda, Jupyter), Data Manipulation
with pandas, Visualization with matplotlib, Advanced Visualization
with seaborn, pandas + Visualization Integration, Real-World
Projects: Hands-on Data Analysis, Best Practices: Coding & Data
Management, Descriptive Analytics Applications- Retail: Sales
trends, Inventory Management etc.
